requirement_results.command: the Helm chart (Chart.yaml) is present and well-formed (apiVersion v2, name ocor-poc, type application)
profile-contract.yaml renders the whole `ocor` values tree verbatim into a ConfigMap via toYaml, not a hand-copied subset
the complete helm values contract passes the fail-closed oracle with zero violations (profile, isolation, images, resource classes, observability, backup, restore, safe-degraded, health)
the compose overlay contract carries the same keys and values as the helm contract (minus the profiles selector), proving the two carriers do not drift
the compose overlay declares exactly the four governed profile modes: observability, backup, safe-degraded, full
docker compose config accepts the overlay as a valid Compose model
the overlay merges cleanly with the real ocor-bootstrap compose.yaml under the bootstrap environment
every foundation service image is digest-pinned or content-addressed against infra/services.lock.json, with restart=no and a real healthcheck or healthy dependency
enabling public egress is rejected: public egress must be denied
a single synthetic compartment is rejected: at least two synthetic compartments required
placing the Root CA inside the cluster fault domain is rejected: Root CA must sit outside
disabling image digest pinning is rejected: images must be digest-pinned
letting C6/control/audit share the causal batch pool is rejected
a drift scan interval above 60s is rejected: drift scan interval must be <= 60s
logging classified payload is rejected: classified payload must be excluded
an incomplete trace field set is rejected: trace fields incomplete
an incomplete backup authority class set is rejected: authority classes incomplete
an untested backup is rejected: backup.tested must be true
a restore outside an isolated network is rejected: restore must run in an isolated network
an incomplete recovery gate is rejected: recovery gate incomplete
a missing safe-degraded fault entry is rejected: safe-degraded fault table incomplete
a service without both liveness and readiness probes is rejected: health probe missing
an RPO above 15 minutes (20) is rejected: RPO must be <= 15 minutes
full local pytest regression over ocor-runtime/tests/ with OCOR_LIVE_POSTGRES_DSN on the real ocor-bootstrap PostgreSQL instance, zero failures

residual_risks: Observability and backup backends remain Candidate Implementation behind logical contracts (ADD v1.3 §6.1); no image digest is fabricated here — the task proves the contract is complete and fail-closed, not that the backends run end-to-end.
The profile contract is machine-checkable today, but runtime observability/backup/recovery is not yet exercised end-to-end; that is the G6 verification work (OCOR-DEV-0065/0066).
rollback_procedure_verified: deploy/helm/ocor-poc/ is additive only (new files under deploy/helm/ocor-poc/ plus a new test module); reverting is a plain deletion of that tree and removal of its MANIFEST/evidence entries, with zero change to deploy/bootstrap/compose.yaml, infra/services.lock.json or any existing sealed file.
